title: Recording: Stop And Take The Time To Smell The Roses by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Ringo Starr finished recording ‘Stop And Take The Time To Smell The Roses’ for his eighth studio album, Stop And Smell The Roses, on 14 December 1980.

The song was co-written by Starr and Harry Nilsson. The pair had collaborated since 1973’s Ringo. Nilsson also wrote ‘Drumming Is My Madness’ for Starr, and co-produced both songs as well as a re-recording of ‘Back Off Boogaloo’.
